topics.titleTr: Hatasız Saat Dilimi ve Zaman Damgası Yönetimi
topics.titleEn: Handle Time Zones and Timestamps Without Bugs
topics.angle: checklist: store, transmit, and display time correctly across zones
topics.brief: Outline: store UTC, and know instant vs wall-clock time; timestamptz vs timestamp in Postgres; ISO 8601 with offsets on the wire; DST pitfalls and recurring-event storage; the IANA tz database and why it keeps changing; displaying in the user's zone; testing (freeze time, test odd zones like Kathmandu). Verify: timestamptz semantics; DST edge cases. Sources: PostgreSQL date/time docs; IANA tz database.
